steps.eval: (() => { const p = [...document.querySelectorAll('*')].find(e => e.children.length === 0 && /^\d{6}$/.test(e.textContent.trim())); if (p) window.__code = p.textContent.trim(); })()

(() => { const i = document.querySelector('input[name=code]'); const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(i, window.__code); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()
(() => { const s = document.querySelector('select[name=species_id]'); s.selectedIndex = 1; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()
(() => { const s = document.querySelector('select[name=care_plan_id]'); if (s) { s.selectedIndex = 1; s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); } })()
